lines: #When you don't know exactly what to do next, your brain *freezes.*
And nobody gets out of bed for a *wish.*
You'll scroll for hours, not because you're lazy, but because you don't know where to *begin.*
Instead of get fit, it's: walk thirty minutes after *lunch.*
Instead of make money, it's: send three job applications *today.*
Instead of be successful, it's: finish the *first* page.
The other tells you exactly where to put your *feet.*
Break it down until the next step is *obvious.*
So small and clear you could do it with your eyes *closed.*
You just needed to see the *road.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: You're Not Lazy. You're Unclear.
post.caption: Nobody gets out of bed for a wish. Get clear on the next step. 🎯
post.first_comment: What's the next tiny step on your biggest goal? 👇
